label: Line 2: 2025 data with the improved method
description: The 2025 data of 2025-fuel with the improved method (line 2): the method modules reserve-pro-rata (reserve and infrastructure shortfall shared across cropping, pasture and non-agricultural land); recycling-stage (recycling split by stage, origin, dry matter, the law in force and uptake by stage). Compare with 2025-mirror for the effect of the method on the same data.
